note: Provenance for the vendored prebuilt LAME MP3-encoder WASM core. Self-hosted (committed and served same-origin via new URL('./mp3_enc_wasm_bg.wasm', import.meta.url), NOT a runtime CDN dependency); scripts/vendor-wasm.ts co-vendors the *_wasm_bg.wasm + *-core.js pair into dist/. The npm wrapper package is MIT; the compiled encoder is LAME 3.100, LGPL-2.0-or-later. The vendored artifact is the unmodified upstream .wasm byte-for-byte; the loader glue (mp3-enc-core.js) is this repo's own MIT code. Re-vendor + sha256-refresh steps are in BUILD.md.
